rows.grounds: noun denied by preceding negative particle
relative pronoun introducing the desired object
past passive participle functioning as noun

items.question: Is the attainment of whatever diverse goal is desired absolutely certain?
premises: There is no doubt regarding this attainment.
The desired object may be various in kind.
items.inference: Whatever diverse goal is desired is certainly obtained without doubt.
uncertainties: The grammatical role of vividhaṃ and samīhitam as nominative or accusative in this context is slightly ambiguous.
items.plain_english: One indeed obtains whatever various thing is desired; there is no doubt.
